muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --output-datastar-template-data-type=PageData --output-datastar-event-template-data-type=EventData --output-datastar-signals-template-data-type=SignalsData
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page datastar(Page(ctx))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /stream datastar(sse(Stream(ctx, send)))" -}}<li>{{- .Result -}}</li>{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /signals datastar(marshalJSON(Signals(ctx)))" -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Sig struct {
	OK bool `json:"ok"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "page", nil }

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, send func(string) error) { _ = send("row") }

func (Server) Signals(_ context.Context) (Sig, error) { return Sig{OK: true}, nil }

// The build only passes if generation produced all three renamed types.
var (
	_ = PageData[RoutesReceiver, string]{}
	_ = EventData[RoutesReceiver, string]{}
	_ = SignalsData[RoutesReceiver, Sig]{}
)
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("render route", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>page</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("stream route", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/stream", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "event: datastar-patch-elements\ndata: elements <li>row</li>\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("signals route", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/signals", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := `{"ok":true}`; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
